system_texts: The UI designer will begin determining the product's functional design, copy all emails and discussions to the PM, and interact with Christine and her team to ensure usability considerations are incorporated into the design, coordinating with Ed as needed.
The Project Manager will send a copy of the slides to all attendees at the conclusion of the meeting.
Ed will coordinate with Christine to develop the sales plan and determine pricing and market strategy.
Ed will prepare and deliver a written project plan by the next meeting.
ID FIE073 will prepare and deliver a written plan detailing the functional and technical design, the required team, the time frame, and the budget within two weeks.
gold_texts: The marketing expert will prepare a sales/project plan, coordinating costs and marketing strategy with the industrial designer.
The industrial designer will prepare an initial written functional/technical design plan, including staffing, timing and budget, in consultation with marketing.
The user interface designer will study usability/user requirements and work with the industrial designer on user acceptability and testing, keeping marketing informed.
The project manager will send the participants a copy of his presentation slides at the conclusion of this meeting.
